newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan BSPA to tender for 54,000 tonnes soybeans.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan BSPA to tender for 54,000 tonnes soybeans.

text.p: The Taichung division of Taiwan's Breakfast Soybean Procurement Association will tender on Thursday for a 54,000-tonne shipment of U.S., Brazilian or Argentine soybeans, traders said on Wednesday.
The association's Taichung division groups Sino Japan Feed Corp, Chia Hsin, Formosa Oilseed, Fwu Sow Grain and Tay Shan.
Traders said the Taichung division was lured into market by a major purchase on Tuesday by the unaffiliated Kaohsiung division of the association.
"Taichung division is trying to catch up with its competitor's import costs," one trader said.
The BSPA Kaohsiung division bought a 54,000-tonne shipment of Brazilian soybeans at 40.38 U.S. cents per tonne over Chicago futures on a cost and freight basis.
Traders said the purchase price at Tuesday's tender was surprisingly low as the U.S. Gulf basis premium recently has been around 80 U.S. cents per tonne.
